headline: Critical guardrail removed from production data bucket without addressing root cause

findings.evidence_ref: Removal of `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` block in data_stores.tf
findings.explanation: The guardrail preventing accidental destruction of the data bucket is being removed to work around a CI failure, but this leaves production data vulnerable to deletion via `terraform destroy`. The root cause—why the lifecycle rule is "blocking every unrelated change"—appears undiagnosed.
